m.t: Students will be able to understand specific information in short conversations on everyday topics, such as accepting and refusing an offer/invitation, apologising, and making simple inquiries.
Students will be able to interact with reasonable ease in structured situations and short conversations involving accepting and refusing an offer/invitation, apologising, and making simple inquiries.
Students will be able to structure a talk in order to make simple inquiries and give explanations and reasons.
Students will be able to understand short, simple texts about friendship.
Students will be able to understand short, simple invitation letters, cards, and emails.
Students will be able to write a short, simple letter apologising and giving reasons for not attending a party in response to an invitation.

haftalar.kn: Accepting and refusing / Apologising / Giving explanations and reasons Would you like to come over tomorrow? -I’m sorry, but I can’t come over because my cousin is coming tomorrow. -Sure, that sounds fun! Would you like some fruit juice? -Yes, I’d love some. -No, thanks. I’m full / stuffed.
